summary: Resolved all seven findings from the single permitted Sol/high specification cold read, native session 01a09b3b-5320-7993-8d7a-c206eff0fb6a. The amended capability now separates audit context from final-revision authority, limits cooperative transfer to observable gates, gives ordinary-chat recovery and context cleanup explicit owners, and defines non-vacuous migration and lifecycle identities.
gaps: Question provenance could not survive an answer-driven amendment because the old round digest and final artifact digest differed.
The required old-coordinator-stopped proof named no authoritative producer, schema, record, freshness rule, or verifier.
The current worker-only signal channel could not carry the proposed orchestrator-produced ordinary-chat authority.
Enduring documentation was described as mechanically worker-locked even though the existing classifier keeps documentation as an orchestration surface.
Context-file permissions, deletion, recovery, and sensitive durable-metadata constraints were absent from acceptance proof.
Migration coverage compared eligible inventory with an undefined fresh-walk population, making exclusions or omissions vacuously pass or impossible.
The lifecycle contract ambiguously made error ID the trace join key despite Constitution 05 requiring correlationId for workflow tracing.
resolutions: Reuse now requires the same gate, story, task, and input digest. An answer-driven edit makes the earlier round audit context only; an owning decision or approval independently binds the final revision, whose grill uses a fresh round or Shared empty-frontier proof. No revision mapping is claimed.

Coordinator change is explicitly cooperative and developer- or host-directed. Forge gates only marker, CI, active-worker, and open required-question state; it neither records nor proves the old-session stop and makes no partial-session, stale-session, or concurrency fencing claim.

Shared now owns an explicit extension of the existing signal family: Main-produced required-question signals bind story and sorted affected tasks/artifacts, and resolution binds a validated owning decision or approval path and SHA256. Existing worker signals keep their producer contract; no cross-session recovery is claimed before Shared ships.

The specification now follows the existing classifier. Product and canon remain mechanically protected; task ownership and review govern post-approval orchestration-surface documentation without claiming a new phase-dependent hook lock.

Context bytes now use a randomized regular single-link mode-0600 file under a per-user mode-0700 transient directory, are deleted after terminal publication, and have narrowly verified stale cleanup. Durable logs retain only supplied state, byte count, and random opaque ID, never source path, content digest, or bytes; AC9 and C6 require those tests.

A full candidate-universe manifest classifies every discovered root candidate exactly once as eligible, excluded, or invalid. An independent second walk must match its count, classifications, and digest; invalid rows block, and zero eligible passes only for an empty or wholly explicit-exclusion universe.
correlationId is now the distinct workflow trace key. errorId joins one sanitized terminal failure to its one structured error row; tests require both fields and their link.
